query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend advanced exergy analysis techniques to optimize energy efficiency in our pilot plant's low-temperature hydrocarbon separation process using mixed refrigerant cycles, addressing specific inefficiencies.
query_analysis.primary_domain: Exergy Analysis in Cryogenic Hydrocarbon Separation

communication_strategy.information_flow: Calculated exergy efficiencies inform process optimization recommendations
